admissionInfo.text: Admission to Professional Education status is a requirement for enrollment in professional studies level courses. Admission criteria includes: ENGL and MATH QL courses must have a grade C or higher. GPA of 3.0 or higher with no grade lower than a C in content area courses. Completion of all General Education requirements and 70% of content area courses. Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check.
